invariants.title: Exclusive declaration ownership
invariants.conformanceMessage: Every observed member has exactly one declaring classifier.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one observed member has zero or multiple declaring classifiers.

invariants.title: Acyclic generalization
invariants.conformanceMessage: No inheritance cycle exists in the exact resolved internal generalization graph.
invariants.violationMessage: An inheritance cycle exists in the exact resolved internal generalization graph.

invariants.title: Inherited view derivation
invariants.conformanceMessage: The frontend-observed inherited view equals the Alloy-derived view.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one frontend-observed inherited membership differs from the Alloy-derived view.

invariants.title: Local and inherited separation
invariants.conformanceMessage: Local and frontend-observed inherited memberships are atom-disjoint.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one member atom is both local and inherited in the same classifier.

invariants.title: Local namespace uniqueness
invariants.conformanceMessage: Local method keys and attribute names are unique within each classifier.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one classifier contains a duplicate method key or attribute name.
